question.wording: Which MACRS recovery period does this capitalized cost take?

options.label: 27.5 years — residential rental building, a structural component (furnace, water pipes, venting) or an addition or improvement such as a new roof
7 years — office furniture and equipment, or property with no other class
5 years — computers, office machinery, automobiles, light trucks, appliances, carpets, furniture used in the rental

default.because: A cost capitalized on a rental is taken as part of the building (a structural component or an improvement) unless a preparer picks another class from Pub. 527 Table 2-1.

citation.wording: Residential rental property (buildings or structures) and structural components such as furnaces, waterpipes, venting, etc.
